messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 3155007777 — P1: serving-runtime-prod cluster: node-prod-33 flapping, repeated CUDA illegal memory access observed. Auto-escalation to oncall. Impact: increased 5xxs and long tails for text-generation routes.
Alice Chen: seeing repeated 'CUDA illegal memory access' in runtime logs, stack trace shows misaligned address in pagewalk path. Example: 
```
E 03:12:47 kernel: gpu0: illegal memory access at 0x7fffe9f2c000
E 03:12:47 runtime: kernel_pagewalk: misaligned pte idx=5 va=0x7fffe9f2c034
E 03:12:48 serving: container crash (exit 137) on prod-33
```
Alice Chen: root cause unclear, could be kernel bug or pinned buffer race during live paging.
Mateo Ruiz: I pulled node logs and dmesg, there's a pattern: pagewalk faults spike when eviction rate > 60/s. Possibly racing with our direct-GPU DMA during container startup.
Priya Singh: customer SLOs show 3 customers with visible errors: app-botcorp, docsnap, and searchly. Error rates for generation API up from 0.3% -> 12% since 03:10.
Jordan Lee: oncall — I'm patching a quick routing rule to divert traffic off prod-33 to prod-12 and prod-21. Doing a partial canary redirect.
oncall: acknowledged. Please post status when traffic is shifted.
Jordan Lee: routed 70% of new sessions away from prod-33 via routing-control; we kept warm connections pinned for latency-sensitive customers.
Mateo Ruiz: suggestion: disable prefetching of large pinned buffers on prod-33 to avoid concurrent mmap page growth during kernel pagewalk. Patch live config in container runtime: set ENV GPU_PREFETCH="0" and reduce prealloc to 128MB.
Alice Chen: can we do that without a full container restart? We need to avoid mass restarts during live traffic.
Mateo Ruiz: we can update env for new pods only. For existing crashed containers we need restart. I'll coordinate rolling restart in waves of 5 pods.
Priya Singh: SRE request: prepare a customer-impact note for customers affected. Minimal message: we are investigating a GPU runtime fault causing elevated 5xxs, mitigation applied, will follow up with RCA.
SRE Pager: assigning follow-up owner for post-incident RCA: @Alice Chen and @Mateo Ruiz.
Alice Chen: taking on RCA with Mateo. Initial hypothesis: kernel address-translation race triggered by concurrent on-demand population of GPU-backed pages while MMU notifier callbacks hit in-flight pagewalks.
Jordan Lee: we should cordon node-prod-33 to prevent new pods landing. Running: `kubectl cordon node-prod-33 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 node-prod-33`
deploy-bot: deploy 3155.12 to runtime-configs: GPU_PREFETCH=0 — deployment started, rolling update policy applied.
Jordan Lee: drain started. Evicted 12 pods. Two pods crash on restart with same illegal memory access in logs — they likely had dirty pinned state.
Mateo Ruiz: I'm collecting coredumps. Running `gcore` on a crashed runtime container and `file /proc/*/map` to inspect mapping. Also pulling `nvidia-smi` output and pci device resets.
Alice Chen: found one backtrace showing kernel module 'mmu_ext' path failing to validate pte alignment. Paste snippet: 
```
#0  mmu_ext_pagewalk+0x1b4/0x2f0
#1  translate_va+0x54/0x80
#2  gpu_vma_fault+0x3c/0x90
#3  handle_page_fault+0x70/0xa0
```
Priya Singh: status update for customers (draft): "We observed a GPU runtime error causing increased errors for short periods. We have rerouted traffic and applied mitigations; our engineers are investigating and will provide a full RCA." OK to send?
Jordan Lee: send now to affected customers, mention mitigations. Add ETA for RCA in 48h.
Alice Chen: mitigation step 1: cordon + drain node-prod-33 — done. Step 2: rolled runtime-config to disable prefetch — new pods stable on other nodes. Step 3: we attempted to reboot node-prod-33 to clear GPU state, but node did not come up cleanly; kernel oops appears on boot in module mmu_ext.
Mateo Ruiz: ordering hardware team to RMA GPU on prod-33 (ticket HW-9982) — but need to know if this is software-only. Trying a microcode downgrade on the node to older NVIDIA driver (525 -> 510) in a staging replica to see if that affects behavior.
SRE Pager: please capture firmware & driver versions and include in incident log.
Alice Chen: logged driver mismatch: vendor driver 525.60.13, container runtime expects 525.85.05. There's a slight mismatch after recent kernel updates. Could be exposing a corner in GPU kernel ops.
Priya Singh: impact summary so far: 3 customers with increased 5xxs; overall platform 99th latency for generation routes increased from 400ms -> 1.8s during spike. No data exfiltration, no model corruption.
Jordan Lee: we've restored most traffic to healthy nodes; current error rate down to 0.8% and tail latency improving. Holding on further restarts.
Mateo Ruiz: long-term mitigation options: 1) pin driver & kernel combos to tested matrix, 2) add kernel-level guard in our runtime to serialise pagewalks during pinned buffer growth, 3) introduce pre-emptive VM reservation to avoid on-demand expanding mmaps at runtime.
Alice Chen: for now, set a temporary rollout policy: block kernel updates on inference fleet until RCA complete. I'll prepare a changelog entry.
deploy-bot: policy change 3155.13 applied: kernel auto-updates disabled on serving nodes.
Priya Singh: action items: Alice+Mateo RCA, Jordan coordinate customer comms, SRE Pager post-incident review. Set P1 ticket and link logs.
SRE Pager: incident status -> mitigated. Low-level errors persist on prod-33; node is cordoned and under hardware review. Will keep incident open until RCA.
Alice Chen: quick note for RCA: capture VM map of crashed processes, collect pagemap, kpageflags, and mmu_notifier traces. If anyone else has reproducible steps in staging, ping me.
Mateo Ruiz: I have a staging repro when eviction rate > 55/s + concurrent heavy host-to-device copies. Reproscript: `stress-ng --vm 2 --vm-bytes 80% & python load_gpu.py --copies 2000` — shared privately.
Jordan Lee: final status for channel: mitigations applied, traffic mostly restored, node-prod-33 cordoned for hardware/kernel review, customer notices sent. Will update when RCA draft ready. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 3155007777 status changed to MITIGATED at 03:58:42.
